$comment: @bugsnag/js (its browser build), @bugsnag/browser, @bugsnag/react-native: `notify` POSTs an event to the notify endpoint; `start` / `createClient` start a session (POST to the sessions endpoint) since `autoTrackSessions` is true by default, none when the code sets it to false (`offWhen`); `startSession` sends one too. The API key goes in the `Bugsnag-Api-Key` header. Endpoints the code gives (`endpoints: { notify, sessions }`) replace the hosts: at `start` itself, through a client `createClient` returns, and for the package's own functions (`Bugsnag.notify`) from the project's one `start` call (`createClient` sets no client for them). `leaveBreadcrumb` and the other client methods send nothing.
